lines.greeting: {greeting} Follow my instructions. Remember - a deliberate and steady hand wins the day. To indicate direction I will just say, “Go clock” or “Go anti.” Let’s crack on, shall we.
lines.open: Door open. Congratulations! You cracked it!
lines.restartSearch: The direction changed during the search. Restart this guided session.
lines.firstPairing: Wheel four is identified. Three readings remain: we’ll test their possible assignments.
lines.nextPairing: Try the next gate assignment. Keep wheel four’s reading.
lines.swapPairing: Still locked. That rules out this trial.
lines.pairingsFailed: None of the trials opened it. Restart the search.

steps.command: Let’s try the bolt. Turn the handle.

searches.command: First we start with four turns to find four unique gate positions. Go clockwise.
searches.complete: Four unique gate positions found. Next we discover to which wheel they correspond.
Wheel four matches the clockwise gate near {number}. Three readings remain.

confidence.mismatch: The readings are not isolated or distinct enough. Restart the slow search.
confidence.unisolated: More than one wheel could be moving. That reading is inconclusive.
